thread:
laura: Heads-up: Kibana trace view is missing spans for a subset of /v1/generate requests in eu-west1 GPU pool for the last ~90m. APIGW shows the requests but Kibana trace join returns nothing. Anyone else seeing gaps?

mike: Yep seeing the same. Grafana SLO panel shows a 13:45–14:10 spike in trace-missing events. Ingest rate also jumped. Could be compactor/index rotation backlog.

anya: deploy-bot fired an index-rotation alert at 2026-03-17T14:02:12Z. Can you paste a sample trace_id?

laura: Sure: 7f8a9c3d4e5f2b1a. APIGW log snippet: `trace_id=7f8a9c3d4e5f2b1a path="/v1/generate" status=200 latency_ms=210`. Kibana query `trace.id:"7f8a9c3d4e5f2b1a"` returns nothing for eu-west1.

mike: Running a Loki filter now. Quick loki query I tried from prod:
```
{app="ingest"} |= "trace_id=7f8a9c3d4e5f2b1a" | json
```
No hits from eu cluster. Try with explicit cluster label:
```
{cluster="eu-west1", job="loki-push"} |= "trace_id=7f8a9c3d4e5f2b1a"
```

anya: Checking cluster: loki-compactor restarted earlier and the compactor backlog alarm fired. Suggest `kubectl -n observability get pods` and look at `loki-compactor` logs for OOM or slow flush.

ben: FYI cost side — ingestion spike at ~13:50 increased billable ingest by ~120GB/hr for that hour. If this is from noisy host logs, we should temporarily reduce sampling.

mike: Confirmed: compactor was OOMKilled at 13:47 (oom kernel event), restarted 13:51, backlog estimated ~2.3M log entries. That explains missing trace joins: index flush delayed so Kibana can't join spans until compactor finishes compaction.

laura: Any quick workaround to surface missing traces for customers while compactor catches up? We need to correlate a few user complaints quickly.

anya: Options (ranked):
- Re-run join from raw push logs (heavy and slow)
- Temporarily scale compactor replicas and increase memory so backlog drains faster
- Route recent API logs to an alternate index/bucket and run temporary join there (less risky)
Pick what SRE is comfortable doing.

mike: Quick actionable: scale loki-compactor to 2 replicas + bump memory to 2Gi. I'll do a controlled scale and watch backlog metrics. Command: `kubectl -n observability scale deploy/loki-compactor --replicas=2` then `kubectl patch deploy/loki-compactor -p \"{\"spec\":{\"template\":{\"spec\":{\"containers\":[{\"name\":\"loki-compactor\",\"resources\":{\"limits\":{\"memory\":\"2Gi\"},\"requests\":{\"memory\":\"1Gi\"}}}]}}}}\"`

deploy-bot: Deploy started by mike at 2026-03-17T14:18:30Z -> scaling loki-compactor to 2 replicas.

laura: While that rolls, I can pull APIGW raw logs from S3 for the impacted trace ids and attach to INF ticket. Can someone confirm S3 path?

ben: S3 path is `s3://redwood-prod-logs/eu-west1/apigw/YYYY/MM/DD/`. I'll add a short script and drop it in the ticket. Also, I'll spin up a Grafana ad-hoc panel to show ingestion rate vs compactor backlog so support can watch.

anya: Prometheus side: our `LokiCompactorBacklogHigh` alert was firing but had an old suppression rule which muted slack. I updated the alerting policy to reduce noisy duplicates and increase threshold slightly so we don't get alert churn for transient restarts. Also: SLO noise came from inconsistent sampling labels — added `sampled=true` label to push pipeline so joins can filter reliably.

mike: Scale is complete, pods are Running. Observability metrics: `loki_compactor_pending_entries = 2.3e6` -> 1.1e6 within 6m and falling.

laura: Retried Kibana search for 7f8a9c3d4e5f2b1a — now returns spans from node `eu-west1-gpu-23`. We're good. Thanks all.

ben: Created ticket INF-3319 (linked to billing) with rough cost estimate for the temporary compactor scaling and proposed long-term fixes: increase compactor HA, larger memory, and smarter sampling for GPU-heavy routes.

anya: Follow-ups assigned: 1) instrument per-node push-rate alerts (owner: laura), 2) increase compactor memory in cluster template and add a runaway OOM guard (owner: mike), 3) revisit sampling policy for GPU / inference endpoints to avoid skew (owner: ben).

laura: I'll update the customer-facing status note and close the loop with support.

mike: leaving the snippet we used for future troubleshooting: `{"query": "{app=\"ingest\", region=\"eu-west1\"} |= \"trace_id=\" | json | line_format \"{trace_id} {host} {msg}\""}`

deploy-bot: Scale complete at 2026-03-17T14:22:01Z.

laura: :thumbsup:

mike: :thumbsup:

ben: noted and tagging billing :eyes:"
